name: lyrics-overlay
description: Ventana flotante de letras sincronizadas para YouTube Music

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check build/desktop/main.js && node --check build/desktop/preload.js && node --check build/desktop/renderer.js && node --check build/desktop/preferences.js && node --check build/extension/content.js && node --check build/extension/popup.js
